traps: 📄 Built from the SLIDES only (lecture Mon 11/16) — stars and corrections update when the transcript arrives.
Meninges outside → in: DURA → ARACHNOID → PIA (DAP). Pia is the one stuck to nervous tissue and follows vessels in (slides 39, 42).

Spaces: EPIDURAL = outside dura, fat-filled, spinal cord ONLY (brain has NO epidural space — dura fused to skull periosteum) · SUBDURAL = POTENTIAL space (open only as an artifact) · SUBARACHNOID = real space with CSF + blood vessels + arachnoid trabeculae (slides 40, 43, 47).

FALX CEREBRI = longitudinal cerebral fissure (left vs right hemispheres), holds dorsal sagittal sinus · TENTORIUM CEREBELLI = transverse cerebral fissure (cerebrum vs cerebellum), partly dura + partly bone (slides 44–46).

Lumens: telencephalon = LATERAL ventricles · diencephalon = THIRD ventricle · mesencephalon = MESENCEPHALIC (cerebral) AQUEDUCT, not a ventricle · metencephalon + myelencephalon = FOURTH ventricle (medulla = caudal ½ only) · spinal cord = central canal (slides 9, 18, 25, 33, 49).
3-vesicle → 5-vesicle: prosencephalon splits (telencephalon + diencephalon), rhombencephalon splits (metencephalon + myelencephalon); the MESENCEPHALON stays ONE segment (slide 6).
Colliculi: ROSTRAL = VISUAL reflexes, CAUDAL = AUDITORY reflexes. Same pattern in the metathalamus: LATERAL geniculate = VISUAL, MEDIAL geniculate = AUDITORY (slides 22, 26).

Fiber types: PROJECTION = to/from brainstem + spinal cord (internal capsule) · COMMISSURAL = between hemispheres (corpus callosum, fornix/hippocampal commissure, rostral commissure) · ASSOCIATION = within the same hemisphere (slide 13).

Cerebral vs cerebellar arteries: 3 CEREBRAL (rostral, middle, caudal) come off the arterial CIRCLE; 2 CEREBELLAR (rostral, caudal) come off the BASILAR artery. Only rostral + caudal cerebral show on the MEDIAL surface (slide 37).

Cerebellar peduncles: MIDDLE = continuous with transverse fibers of the pons · CAUDAL = to medulla oblongata · ROSTRAL = mainly EFFERENT (cerebellum → brainstem). Don't flip 'cerebellar peduncle' (cerebellum ↔ brainstem) with 'cerebral peduncle' (midbrain, continues into internal capsule) (slides 27, 31).

CSF made by CHOROID PLEXUS (all ventricles), leaves via LATERAL APERTURES of the 4th ventricle, reabsorbed by ARACHNOID VILLI into the DORSAL SAGITTAL SINUS — production ≠ exit ≠ drainage (slides 55–61).
Pons: TRANSVERSE fibers = visible ventral bar; LONGITUDINAL fibers lie DORSAL to them, continue the crus cerebri, NOT visible on surface (slide 29).

items.q: CSF life cycle: produced → exits → reabsorbed (slides 55–61)?

Choroid plexus — specialized membrane that secretes CSF
Roof and walls of all ventricles; lateral + third ventricles share choroid plexus where they communicate

Tight junctions between the (modified) ependymal cells of the choroid plexus

items.q: FYI choroid plexus functions beyond CSF (slide 58)?
